body.content: Considering the 'distinguishing evidence' part of the problem: if a panel follows a checklist and gets it right, is that 'reliability' or just 'luck' (tracking)? If we introduce a 'decoy' item into the checklist—a step that is logically irrelevant but looks plausible—compliance-driven panels will mark it as 'done' regardless of the facts. A reliability-driven panel would question the decoy. This could be a way to distinguish genuine judgment from blind adherence.
body.why_keep_this: Provides a concrete experimental design for the second part of the prompt.
